item.text: {"search_note":"I did not find strong 2024 evidence of Sharif personally issuing a new command-and-control reform, custody protocol, or accident-prevention directive.\nI also did not find reliable 2024 evidence of a safeguard failure, custody lapse, or public controversy over nuclear safety under his watch.\nSo the best-supported reading is mildly favorable but low-confidence: the available material points to continued institutional discipline, not clearly documented new strengthening by Sharif himself.","evidence":[{"title":"Pakistan's nuclear programme is for peaceful purposes: PM","publisher":"Radio Pakistan","date":"2024-12-24","url":"https://www.radio.gov.pk/24-12-2024/pm-vows-to-root-out-scourge-of-terrorism","summary":"Sharif said Pakistan’s nuclear program is for peaceful purposes, for self-defense, and has no aggressive designs. This is not a technical safeguard announcement, but it is a direct public stewardship statement consistent with disciplined custody and non-escalatory control of nuclear assets.","question_ids":["1B.3","1B.1","1B.2"]},{"title":"Pakistan's Nuclear Safety & Security Regime","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Pakistan","date":"2024-05","url":"https://www.mofa.gov.pk/vienna-pakistans-nuclear-safety-seccurity-regime","summary":"Pakistan’s official nuclear-security page says the NCA is chaired by the prime minister, the SPD serves as secretariat, and in May 2024 Pakistan published an updated nuclear security regime booklet and a practical arrangement with the IAEA. This is the strongest 2024 evidence of command-and-control and safeguards architecture during Sharif’s term, though it is institutional rather than a personal action by him.","question_ids":["1B.3"]},{"title":"Pakistan’s election as the President for the Tenth Review Meeting of the Convention on Nuclear Safety (CNS)","publisher":"Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Pakistan","date":"2024-09-05","url":"https://mofa.gov.pk/press-releases/pakistans-election-as-chair-of-convention-on-nuclear-security-cns","summary":"Pakistan said the election of PNRA chairman Faizan Mansoor as CNS president reflected international trust in Pakistan’s nuclear-safety record. This supports an inference that the safety and oversight regime remained credible in 2024 under Sharif’s government, though it does not prove any specific new safeguard initiative by him.","question_ids":["1B.3"]}]}
